meta.name: Shwetkali
meta.description: Families of Urvi and Palash's arrive at Kharapani Mansion to celebrate their engagement. As the house starts getting prepared for the upcoming engagement ceremony, a wall breaks and there emerges the eerie idol of a white kali ..Shwetkali.

videos.title: Is The Rajbari Haunted?
videos.overview: The Chatterjee family reaches Kharapani to celebrate Palash and Urvi's engagement. Everyone is excited about their stay at Rajbari. But are the walls of the mansion hiding a centuries-old curse within them?

videos.title: The Curse of Kali
videos.overview: A broken wall in the house reveals a beautiful idol of Shwetkali. Balaram Thakur, the village priest, asks the family to worship it as Narendrapratap did. But who is Narendrapratap?

videos.title: Who Killed Gogol?
videos.overview: The family's beloved dog, Gogol, is found brutally murdered. The villagers insist that Pujo is completed. Urvi holds Balaram's son responsible for the dog's death.

videos.title: The Mysterious Shadow
videos.overview: The family remains divided over the decision to offer an animal as a sacrifice. At night, some members witness an eerie instance. Will the family's decision not to sacrifice an animal cost them dear?

videos.title: The Bloodthirsty Shwetkali
videos.overview: The death of a family member turns the celebrations into mourning. The police and the locals believe that the goddess is taking her sacrifice by herself. But Urvi doesn't believe this.

videos.title: The Diary of Narendrapratap
videos.overview: Arunava and Urvi find an old diary belonging to the zamindar, Narendrapratap. The diary reveals the inception of the myth of Shwetkali. Does Balaram Thakur know more than he is letting on?

videos.title: The Impotent Zamindar
videos.overview: Urvi learns more details about Narendrapratap's life and finds similarities between the incidents that happened 150 years ago and the ones happening now. Balaram Thakur warns her of the danger looming on her family.

videos.title: Case Closed?
videos.overview: An epic showdown in the middle of the forest reveals the actual culprit. Is it really the goddess or the devil reincarnate?

videos.title: Guha Kali Awakens
videos.overview: Pregnant Urvi visits Megh-Jhuri as Tara is hailed as Goddess Guha Kali and predicts Ahana’s death.

videos.title: Ahana’s Fatal Fate
videos.overview: As Tara’s strange behaviour sparks fear, Ahana dies from a snakebite, reviving Guha Kali's curse.

videos.title: Secrets Beneath the Curse
videos.overview: Tara demands more sacrifices as Urvi and Himal probe the curse and uncover Banalata’s secret.

videos.title: The Curse Claims Two More Lives
videos.overview: Urvi suspects murders behind the curse as Himal and Jhilmil die, deepening the mystery.

videos.title: Tara Turns the Tables
videos.overview: Urvi investigates Tara’s mental state, but Tara exposes her, while signs of a miscarriage emerge.

videos.title: A Crime Buried for Generations
videos.overview: Urvi saves Birsa from sacrifice and uncovers the crime against Moina behind the decades-old curse.

videos.title: Deadly Conspiracy Exposed
videos.overview: Urvi exposes a deadly conspiracy born of repeated miscarriages and a desire for motherhood.
